limits: Genuine-read tests use one fixed internal comparator coordinate per dataset in L/R directions; they do not measure natural telomere completion.
The larger ONT pool contains the smaller pool and is not an independent locus or replicate.
Reverse complements retain the same read ID and do not add independent support.
Support counts are lower bounds; up to 200 outward junction bases are checked, not the whole selected tail.
Query-unique anchors are not proven genome-wide unique; sampled exact keys can miss error-rich alignments.
HiFi repetitive-region retrieval still returns many candidates; no top-N truncation is used.
Comparator identities cover full joined sequences including 30 kb retained chromosome; they are not tail-only accuracy estimates.
The larger ONT L join has 133 outer query bases clipped/unmapped by the comparator; no claim is made that the complete added tail is correct.
Archive report derivatives are rerenders of preserved completed work, not fresh biological searches; archives are inspection evidence, not portable resumable workspaces.
No GPM bundled runtime refresh, browser acceptance, release, merge or tag is included.
